department: Department of Chemical and Materials Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants: April 1 for Fall (September) 2027 entry; October 1 for Winter.

gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is optional.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT taken on/after 21 Jan 2026: 5 overall with at least 4.5 per section (older tests: 92 with 21 per section).
toefl_min.quote: For tests written on or after January 21, 2026: 5 with at least 4.5 in each section or equivalent | For tests written before January 21, 2026: 92 with at least 21 in each section or equivalent

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 6.0 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: an overall band score of 7.0 on IELTS with at least 6.0 on each band

english_waiver.value: Only degrees from Canada, USA, UK, Australia or New Zealand are exempt, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: if the previous degree was not obtained from Canada, USA, UK, Australia or New Zealand, proof of English Language Proficiency is still required

supervisor.value: The pages checked do not say whether a supervisor must agree before you apply.

funding.value: Four years of guaranteed funding: CAD 27,000 a year for international students (CAD 25,000 for Canadians/PRs).
funding.quote: 4 years of Guaranteed Funding Canadian Citizens / Permanent Residents $25K and international students $27K

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a BSc needs at least a 3.5/4 average in the last two years; master's holders enter the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Students applying to a PhD program directly from a BSc must have an average of at least 3.5 on a four-point scale

notes: Specializations: Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Process Control. CV, one-page personal statement and three references.
